title: How do I choose a career?
summary: Career Choices: Questions and Answers
answer: Start with your interests, strengths and values. Compare the everyday work and entry requirements of a few options. Try a small project, course or conversation with someone in the field, then review what you learned before choosing your next step.

title: How can I organise my job search?
summary: Job Search: Questions and Answers
answer: Choose a small set of target roles, tailor each application and keep a tracker with the employer, role, date, status and next action. Review responses regularly and improve one part of your approach at a time.

title: How should I prepare for an interview?
summary: Interview Preparation: Questions and Answers
answer: Read the role requirements, research the employer and prepare a few truthful examples of relevant skills. Practise explaining your own actions and results. Confirm the format, time and meeting details, and prepare questions for the interviewer.

title: How can I work effectively from home?
summary: Remote Work: Questions and Answers
answer: Agree priorities, working hours and communication expectations with your team. Use a suitable workspace, follow employer security requirements, plan focused work and breaks, and keep shared tasks and progress notes current.

title: How do I plan my professional development?
summary: Professional Development: Questions and Answers
answer: Choose a skill that matters to your current role or next goal. Plan a learning activity and a practical way to use it. Keep evidence, ask for feedback and set a review date so you can adjust the plan based on progress.
